concepts.question: Are the banded retinal layers continuous and regularly stacked across the scan?

intact.text: every band, down to the thin bright ellipsoid-zone line, runs unbroken from one edge of the frame to the other

mildly_disrupted.text: one or two bands blur or break over less than about a quarter of the frame width, and the stacking order stays readable throughout

markedly_disrupted.text: banding is lost over more than about a quarter of the frame width, or layers are so displaced that their order cannot be traced

concepts.question: Does the retinal surface at the centre form a smooth shallow depression?

depressed.text: the inner surface dips into a smooth shallow concave pit whose floor lies below the inner surface on either side

flattened.text: the central dip is shallow or gone, so the inner surface runs almost level across the middle of the frame

elevated.text: the centre of the inner surface bulges upward and stands higher than the inner surface to either side of it

concepts.question: How thick is the retina between its inner surface and the bright outer band?

not_increased.text: the retina is at its thinnest in the centre of the frame and grows thicker towards both edges

mildly_increased.text: the central retina is as thick as, or a little thicker than, the retina at the edges of the same frame

markedly_increased.text: the central retina is more than about half again as thick as the retina at the edges of the same frame

concepts.question: Are there rounded dark low-reflectivity pockets inside the retinal layers?

absent.text: the layers between the inner surface and the bright outer band are evenly banded, with no dark rounded pocket among them

few_small.text: one to three dark rounded pockets, each under about a third of the retinal thickness tall, with retinal tissue both above and below it

many_or_large.text: four or more such pockets, or one taller than half the retinal thickness, each still roofed and floored by retinal tissue

concepts.question: Is there a dark empty space lifting the retina off the bright band beneath it?

absent.text: the outermost retinal bands sit directly on the bright outer band, with no dark gap between the two

small.text: a shallow dark gap floored only by the bright outer band lifts the outermost retinal bands by under about a quarter of the retinal thickness

large.text: a dome of dark space raises the whole outer retina more than a quarter of the retinal thickness above the bright outer band

concepts.question: Is the bright outer band smooth, gently domed in small bumps, or focally lifted?

smooth.text: the bright outer band follows one even curve, and no bump on it is wider than about a hundredth of the frame width (63 um)

small_domed_undulations.text: one or more smooth rounded domes lift the band, each under about a twentieth of the frame width, the band thin and unbroken over each

large_irregular_elevation.text: a single lift wider than about a twentieth of the frame width, or one whose top is ragged, angular or multi-peaked rather than a smooth dome

concepts.question: Is there bright solid-looking material between the retina and the bright outer band?

absent.text: the outermost retinal bands meet the bright outer band directly, with nothing bright and solid-looking interposed

small.text: one bright patch lies between them, under about a third of the retinal thickness tall and narrower than a twentieth of the frame width

extensive.text: bright material between them fills more than about a third of the retinal thickness, or runs wider than a twentieth of the frame width

concepts.question: Are there small bright dots or specks scattered within the darker retinal layers?

absent.text: no discrete bright dot stands out from the darker layers lying above the bright outer band

few.text: up to about ten separate bright dots, each no larger than the bright outer band is thick (30 um), scattered through the darker layers

many.text: more than about ten such dots, often gathered into clusters or strung along one layer

concepts.question: Do bright structures cast vertical dark columns into the tissue beneath them?

absent.text: tissue directly beneath every bright structure is as bright as the tissue beside it at the same depth

mild.text: one faint dim column sits under a bright structure, no wider than that structure, and the layers it crosses can still be made out

marked.text: dark columns under several bright structures blank out the layers beneath them all the way to the bottom of the frame
